title: Palantir Stock (PLTR) Falls 2.1% as Tech Stocks Slide (Nov 13)
summary: Palantir stock (PLTR) fell 2.09% to $167.99 on Nov 13, 2026, as tech stocks slid on Nvidia CEO fallout and rising Treasury yields.
body_markdown:
Chip stocks took the heaviest losses among peers:[AMD (AMD)](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/amd/) fell 8.75% and Nvidia slipped 2.01%. Software peer[Oracle (ORCL)](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/orcl/) lost 1.38%. Palantir ended the day 21.11% below its 52-week high of $212.94 and 57.93% above its 52-week low of $106.37.


## Why Palantir Stock Fell


Coverage of the session did not point to a Palantir announcement as the cause of the drop. According to[The Motley Fool](https://www.fool.com/coverage/stock-market-today/2026/11/13/stock-market-midday-nov-13-nasdaq-plunges-as-nvidia-turmoil-deepens-and-treasury-yields-hit-5/) , mounting uncertainty surrounding Nvidia and rising Treasury yields fueled a sharp sell-off in technology stocks on Friday, with selling spreading across the semiconductor industry after[the resignation of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/nvidia-nvda-stock-news-november-13-2026/) . The same report said the climb in the 10-year yield added pressure to stock valuations after another round of inflation data.


Per[TradingKey](https://www.tradingkey.com/news/market-movers/262304843-market-movers-pltr-20261113) , Palantir came under pressure from profit-taking across high-multiple enterprise software and artificial intelligence stocks. The report named no company-specific event behind the move.


On the filing side, Palantir officer Shyam Sankar filed a[Form 144 notice with the SEC](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1321655/000195004726010983/xsl144X01/primary_doc.xml) on November 12, covering a proposed sale of 84,680 shares with an aggregate market value of about $14.3 million around November 11. The notice also lists a sale of 300,000 shares on November 10, and states the sales were made under a Rule 10b5-1 trading plan adopted on August 10, 2026.


## PLTR Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- Third-quarter 2026 revenue rose 96% year over year to $2.313 billion, according to the company's[results release](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1321655/000132165526000045/a2026q3ex991pressrelease.htm) .
- US commercial revenue grew 148% to $984 million, and Palantir raised its full-year 2026 revenue guidance to between $8.530 billion and $8.534 billion, per the same release.
- US commercial remaining deal value reached $6.517 billion, up 79% year over year, the company reported.


### Risks


- Closed total contract value rose 6% year over year to $2.918 billion in the third quarter, per the release, a far slower pace than the 96% revenue growth.
- The 10-year Treasury yield closed at 5.15%, and The Motley Fool linked rising yields to pressure on technology stock valuations.
- Leadership uncertainty at Nvidia has weighed on the wider AI trade, and TradingKey tied Friday's decline in Palantir to profit-taking across AI and software stocks.
